answer: One defence is Attested watchmaker certification with horology institute attestation: a certification the institute renews after bench tests, and the lantern of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the mesa is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the timber of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
